prior_pending_row.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended
prior_pending_row.reason: Pending historical membership reconstruction. HR 2860 EH strikes original sections 403-405, including mandatory organization and operation according to the August 20, 1998 Report on file with Commerce. It proposes four Governor-appointed Washington residents who are not Federal, State or local government employees, excluding higher-education institutions. The Commission repository supplies a 12-page Report to the Convenors with the 1998 cover date and Reprinted 4/04. Its complete membership paragraphs say the remaining Governor appointees will be citizens of the State of Washington and not official State-agency representatives, within the up-to-five, MRC-minus-one and four-year rotating-term qualifications. MRC representation, the Tribal seat, the Puget Sound Action Team seat and informal Canadian governmental participation remain distinct. This citizens/residents comparison is material to candidate source and domain review; neither restore the old exclusion nor automatically include. The reprint contains a retrospective late-1998 summary and 2000/2004 PDF metadata. Original-on-file edition equivalence and the personal-citizenship meaning of the State-citizen phrase still need verification. No US nationality, noncitizen eligibility, actual appointment or immigration result is inferred. The committee narrative corroborates the historical report reference; its literal 105-483 footnotes and shorthand do not replace PL 105-384 or EH wording. Still pending research, without missing-evidence/conflict adjudication or a completed screening. Exact Foushee Yea/Massie Nay and suspension-and-pass observations retained.
